run.trigger: Operations asked the agent to work this case

steps.summary: Bentley Continental GT for Marvellin Motorhandel, Munich → Hamburg. Driver Kasper Kovelund (in progress).
8 recent messages. Latest from Kasper Kovelund: “I will wait here. Please tell me who is collecting the car before anyone moves it.”
2 open alerts (No recent driver-app position; check before changing a promise.), 1 incident, 1 open task.
Last driver-app position 4 h ago (stale), 233 km to go.
no bookings; no quote or capacity checks (not bookings).

input.purpose: Bahn operations checking on you and the stopped Bentley so we can tell the recovery service exactly where the car is; please keep it stopped.
questions: Are you still safe, and is the car still parked with the engine off?
What is the name of the service area, the motorway and direction you were travelling?
Have you been able to send the dashboard warning photo?
Do you have the keys with you, and how long can you stay with the car?

steps.summary: Simulated call Kasper Kovelund. Yes, I'm safe and still at the service-area car park, and the Bentley is parked with the engine off. I'm at Rasthof Frankenwald on the A9, and I was heading north towards Hamburg. Not yet. I'll send the dashboard warning photo to you right after this call.

input.text: The driver says they are safe, still at the service-area car park, engine off, keys with them. The car has not been checked for a fault.

Location not confirmed. On the phone the driver said Rasthof Frankenwald, A9 northbound. That is roughly 450 km from Hamburg, but the last app position (21 Oct 08:00, 4 h old) showed 233 km left. The two don't match and there is no GPS fix.

The driver can stay with the car until "about 14:00 today". They didn't say which clock; if it's German time, that's about 15:00 Helsinki. They want to be told who is collecting before anyone moves the car.
No photo of the dashboard warning yet. The driver says they will send it right after the call.
The customer said to keep the car stopped and that they are asking their service contact about roadside help or collection. No instruction from them yet.
The delivery promise is 21 Oct 13:00–17:00 and is very likely to be missed while the car is stopped. Nothing is booked: no recovery, no travel.

input.title: Call Marvellin Motorhandel for their service instruction on the stopped Bentley
input.rationale: The car is stopped with a red warning and only the owner can decide between roadside help, collection or other custody. The driver can only stay until about 14:00 (clock not confirmed), and the recovery decision is due at 12:15.

changes.before: Waiting for the customer, no instruction

draft_message.body: Call brief: The Bentley Continental GT (CD-420322) is stopped with the engine off after a red dashboard warning and reduced acceleration. Driver Kasper Kovelund is safe and has the keys. The driver says they are at Rasthof Frankenwald, A9 northbound, but this is not confirmed (old app position doesn't match). The warning photo is on its way from the driver. Ask: 1) Does their service contact want roadside assistance, collection by a recovery truck, or something else? 2) Who is attending and when, and do they need a named handover with the driver? 3) Who pays for recovery? Driver can stay until about 14:00 (clock not confirmed). Do not agree a new delivery time on this call; replan separately once recovery is set. Do not say anyone has cleared onward driving.

input.what_happens_next: A coordinator calls the customer with this brief and records their service instruction.
input.what_happens_after: The coordinator has the customer's recovery instruction, tells the driver who is collecting, and then replans the driver and the delivery promise separately.
